$comment: Hooks are the TRIGGER layer. They are deterministic shell processes run by Claude Code
itself -- they are not the agent, and they cannot reason. Keep them small, fast and
fail-open: a hook that crashes must not break the session.
Every hook here is written in Node so they behave identically on Windows and POSIX.
Every hook exits 0 on any internal error, on purpose.
Stop refuses to end the turn while `ast todo` lists owed work, and releases after
three blocks without progress (AST_STOP_GATE=off disables it). UserPromptSubmit records
the user's words so user-attributed holds can be verified.
